approach: Terminology-locked, segment-aligned literature translation Skill: layout-aware paragraph extraction with page/bbox provenance; heuristic domain-term candidates to seed a glossary map; one-term-one-translation enforcement; segment-by-segment translation with context carryover; automatic verification of number/unit, figure/table/equation/citation, logic-marker, and glossary-consistency preservation.
output: scaffold.json (paragraphs/candidate terms/glossary template), translation.json (bilingual segments), verification.json (preservation issues), result.json (status/sources/uncertainty/change_records)
scope: single- and two-column scientific PDFs with a text layer
limitations: translation itself is performed by the calling agent
term candidates are heuristic and must be curated
formulas/tables embedded as images are flagged, not reconstructed
scanned PDFs (no text layer) are flagged for OCR
honest_status: Self-tested scaffold/verification on a public arXiv paper. The three official fixed cases are supplied only by the evaluation platform and are not included here.
